automotive-ev-battery.title: T&E study predicts strong competition for EU electric truck market
automotive-ev-battery.summary: A new Transport & Environment analysis warns that European truck manufacturers face significant competitive threats, with Chinese and US competitors potentially capturing a quarter of the EU electric truck market by 2030. The report highlights a critical juncture for European commercial vehicle manufacturers ahead of the IAA Transportation event.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Waning interest in battery-electric cars? CLEPA survey reveals surprising results
automotive-ev-battery.summary: A European automotive suppliers association survey of the EU's five largest markets found that only 8 percent of respondents intend to purchase an electric car for their next vehicle, representing a significant outlier compared to other recent consumer interest studies. The finding raises questions about the pace of EV market adoption in Europe.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Fraunhofer ISE increases energy density of battery cells
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Researchers at Fraunhofer ISE have developed a new battery cell architecture that achieves 10 to 15 percent higher energy density through the use of significantly thicker electrodes and reduced current collectors. This advancement could have substantial implications for electric vehicle performance and range.

automotive-ev-battery.title: EVgo and Regency expand US fast charging partnership
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Charge point operator EVgo is expanding its partnership with retail company Regency Centers to deploy more than 400 new fast charging stalls across Regency properties nationwide. The expansion represents significant progress in increasing public fast-charging infrastructure availability across the United States.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Volkswagen ID.3 Neo test reveals an electric car that does what it's meant to
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Volkswagen's updated ID.3 Neo features new haptic push button and rotary knob controls replacing previous slider interfaces, while maintaining the model's spacious interior design. The overall refinements position the ID.3 as a genuinely competitive and comprehensive electric vehicle offering.

automotive-ev-battery.title: BAM identifies lithium isotopes as diagnostic tool for battery ageing
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Federal Institute for Materials Research and Testing (BAM) researchers have identified that the distribution of lithium isotopes in battery cells serves as a diagnostic fingerprint directly linked to degradation processes. This discovery could advance understanding of battery aging mechanisms and inform battery lifecycle management strategies.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Australia expands EV rebates for dealerships and repair shops
automotive-ev-battery.summary: The Australian government is expanding EV infrastructure support with rebates up to AU$3,000 per charging plug at dealerships and repair shops, while also covering up to 80 percent of eligible costs for EV-specific workshop equipment. The initiative aims to strengthen the domestic EV ecosystem and support industry transition.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Alpitronic adds compact depot dispenser to HYC1000 Range
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Alpitronic has expanded its HYC1000 megawatt charging system with a new compact depot dispenser capable of delivering up to 400 kW for bus and truck charging operations. The flexible mounting options for walls, pedestals, and traverses will debut at the IAA Transportation event.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Battery storage startup Rebaba secures nearly €4 million
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Rebaba, a Swedish startup founded by former Northvolt employees, has raised nearly €4 million in seed funding to expand its second-life battery storage systems business. The funding will accelerate development of battery repurposing solutions for stationary energy storage applications.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Wallbox Chargers closes US plant – in favour of Spain
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Spanish charging infrastructure manufacturer Wallbox Chargers is relocating US production to Barcelona while maintaining its North American market presence through imports. The restructuring affects manufacturing operations but does not represent a strategic withdrawal from the United States market.

science-space.title: Scientists study 3,000 supernovas and discover that dark energy may be evolving
science-space.summary: A comprehensive analysis of nearly 3,000 Type Ia supernovae from white dwarf explosions suggests that dark energy, the mysterious force driving cosmic expansion, may be changing over time rather than remaining constant. This discovery challenges current cosmological models and could fundamentally reshape our understanding of the universe's fate and composition.

science-space.title: Strange 'fast radio bursts' across the universe could help solve major cosmic mysteries
science-space.summary: Fast radio bursts emanating from across the cosmos present a potential tool for investigating fundamental cosmic mysteries including the nature of dark matter and dark energy. Though their origins remain poorly understood, these mysterious signals offer researchers new avenues for probing the universe's most perplexing phenomena.

science-space.title: Mercury is shrinking faster than we thought. What's going on inside of it?
science-space.summary: New observations of surface wrinkles on Mercury indicate the closest planet to the sun is contracting more rapidly than previously believed, raising important questions about the planet's internal geological processes. This discovery could provide critical insights into Mercury's composition and cooling mechanisms.

science-space.title: NASA Answers President's Call to Establish United States Space Academy
science-space.summary: NASA has launched efforts to establish the first United States Space Academy following a recent executive order, with NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman chairing the inaugural Presidential Commission. The academy aims to develop America's aerospace workforce and strengthen the nation's leadership in space exploration.

science-space.title: Dust and Water in Sagittarius A*
science-space.summary: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope has detected oxygen-rich silicate dust and water signatures near IRS 3, an aging star located in the Sagittarius A* region. The mid-infrared observations provide new insights into stellar composition and the chemical environment surrounding stars nearing the end of their life cycles.

science-space.title: NASA Invites Media to Djibouti Artemis Accords Signing Ceremony
science-space.summary: The Republic of Djibouti will become the 72nd country to sign the Artemis Accords during a ceremony at NASA Headquarters in Washington on September 14. The diplomatic milestone reflects growing international commitment to the principles governing peaceful space exploration and sustainable lunar development.

science-space.title: SpaceX launches classified mission for the US Space Force from California
science-space.summary: SpaceX successfully launched the classified USSF-153 mission for the U.S. Space Force on September 10 from California's central coast. The operation continues the commercial provider's ongoing support of national security space operations.

science-space.title: NASA's Life-Saving Technology Where Cell Signals Can't Go
science-space.summary: Search and rescue technology developed with NASA involvement has successfully saved five lives in emergency situations where conventional cellular communications are unavailable. The dual-use innovation demonstrates the practical humanitarian applications of space-derived technology.

science-space.title: NASA, NFL Team Up to Showcase Space, Aeronautics Innovation
science-space.summary: NASA has launched a new collaboration with the National Football League to conduct flyovers, feature astronaut appearances, and engage fans at NFL games across the United States through the Inspiration Tour. The partnership aims to promote public awareness of American achievements in space exploration and aeronautical innovation.

science-space.title: LINK spacecraft gets close to NASA's Swift Observatory, but not close enough to save it
science-space.summary: The Katalyst Space LINK satellite approached NASA's Swift Observatory but fell short of its mission objective to boost the aging observatory's orbit to extend its operational life. Despite the failed rendezvous, the LINK spacecraft continues its operations while engineers assess next steps.

tech-ai.title: Jensen Huang explains why Nvidia will grow an astounding 70% next year
tech-ai.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang projects the company will experience 70% growth in the coming year, citing its broad involvement across multiple technology segments. Huang emphasized that the company's expansion plans are based on organic demand rather than circular dealings.

tech-ai.title: Anthropic details distillation campaigns from Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek
tech-ai.summary: Anthropic released a report documenting persistent distillation attacks by Chinese AI companies, with incidents escalating as competition intensifies in the artificial intelligence sector. The report highlights ongoing concerns about intellectual property theft and model replication in the competitive AI landscape.

tech-ai.title: OpenAI puts Pro subscriptions on hold due to Astra demand
tech-ai.summary: OpenAI has paused new Pro subscription sign-ups to manage system strain caused by high demand for its Astra product offering. The company is working to increase server capacity to accommodate the surge in usage.

tech-ai.title: Universal Music is launching an AI music platform with ElevenLabs
tech-ai.summary: Universal Music Group announced a multiyear licensing agreement with ElevenLabs to create an AI-powered platform enabling users to generate remixes, mashups, and new interpretations of licensed music. The platform will allow artists to opt in to participate, representing a significant collaboration between a major label and AI music technology company.

tech-ai.title: Proxima Fusion bets €140M on a critical fusion ingredient dominated by Asian suppliers
tech-ai.summary: Proxima Fusion announced plans to invest €140 million ($162.6 million) in building a factory to manufacture fusion-grade high-temperature superconducting tape, a critical component for its reactor design. The investment aims to reduce dependence on Asian suppliers and establish domestic production capacity for essential fusion technology materials.

tech-ai.title: Slack can now vibe-code interactive charts and reports inside chats
tech-ai.summary: Slack is introducing Slackforce Surfaces, a new feature that enables users to build interactive reports, dashboards, and presentations directly within chat using AI-powered Slackbot. The tool can gather information from connected applications like Google Drive and Salesforce based on user descriptions.

tech-ai.title: Meta's AI agent Muse is now the No. 2 app in the US
tech-ai.summary: Meta's new Muse AI assistant application has quickly achieved the number two position in the U.S. app rankings, though it experienced a slower initial launch compared to other Meta products. The app represents the company's expanded focus on productivity-oriented AI tools.

tech-ai.title: Meta's Muse AI works and creeps me out
tech-ai.summary: Meta launched its Muse assistant, marking its first significant productivity-focused AI tool capable of handling online shopping, email management, and trip planning. A hands-on review found the AI agent functionally capable but raising privacy and comfort concerns among some users.

tech-ai.title: Electric air taxis get the green light for test flights in Texas
tech-ai.summary: The FAA's Advanced Air Mobility and Electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing (eVTOL) Integration Pilot Program launched its first public test in Texas, marking a significant milestone for electric and autonomous aircraft development. The testing initiative is proceeding despite final regulatory rules for the technology still being under development.

tech-ai.title: Amazon makes it easier to buy what you see on Prime Video
tech-ai.summary: Amazon is expanding its shopping integration capabilities across Prime Video through enhanced X-Ray features and a new AI-powered "Shop the Scene" tool powered by visual recognition technology. The expansion enables viewers to discover and purchase products tied to thousands of shows, movies, and live sports content.

world-news.title: Iran war live: IRGC attacks US unmanned vessel in Hormuz; two ships hit
world-news.summary: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps attacked a US-operated unmanned vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, with projectiles also striking two additional ships off Oman. The incident escalates maritime tensions in a critical global shipping chokepoint and signals direct military confrontation between Iran and US-aligned interests.

world-news.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
world-news.summary: Iran-backed Houthi forces have reportedly captured the strategic port of Mokha in Yemen, bringing them closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait, one of the world's most critical shipping routes. The seizure carries significant implications for global maritime trade and regional geopolitical balance.

world-news.title: UN envoy warns Security Council Yemen's war has entered 'dangerous phase'
world-news.summary: The UN envoy for Yemen warned the Security Council that the conflict has reached a dangerous escalation point, calling for urgent action to protect civilians and critical trade routes amid renewed Houthi military operations. The warning underscores the deteriorating humanitarian and geopolitical situation in the strategic region.

world-news.title: Israel says it destroyed Hezbollah base in Lebanon's Ali al-Taher ridge
world-news.summary: Israel reported destroying a Hezbollah military base on Lebanon's Ali al-Taher ridge, following its claim of operational control over the strategic position one week prior. The strikes represent ongoing escalation in Israel-Hezbollah hostilities along the Lebanon-Israel border.

world-news.title: Iran claims to have captured a US 'sail drone' near Hormuz Strait
world-news.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard claimed to have seized a US-operated surface drone at the entrance of the Strait of Hormuz, escalating military tensions in the strategically vital waterway. The incident underscores heightened confrontation between Iran and US assets in one of the world's most critical chokepoints for global energy supplies.

world-news.title: Maduro's wife seeks home detention as heart condition worsens in US custody
world-news.summary: The wife of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro has requested home detention while in US custody, citing a worsening cardiac condition requiring specialized medical care unavailable in her detention facility. The case reflects ongoing US-Venezuela tensions and the arrest of close associates of the Maduro government.

world-news.title: Why is Uber pulling out of some African markets?
world-news.summary: Uber has exited ride-hailing operations in Nigeria and Uganda, highlighting persistent challenges for international gig-economy platforms in African markets including regulatory obstacles and profitability constraints. The withdrawals reflect broader tensions between global tech companies and developing market regulations.

world-news.title: Can Trump really pay $5,000 to every American adult?
world-news.summary: Economic analysts have raised serious questions about the feasibility, legality, and affordability of President Trump's proposed pledge to distribute $5,000 to every American adult. The proposal has drawn scrutiny regarding its fiscal impact and constitutional viability.

world-news.title: Israel's Netanyahu to sue newspaper over claim UAE warned him of 7 October attack
world-news.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has announced legal action against a newspaper that published claims from a forthcoming book alleging that the United Arab Emirates warned him in advance of the October 7 attack. The newspaper has stated it stands by its reporting of the controversial allegation.

world-news.title: Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China
world-news.summary: A fire aboard a cargo vessel off eastern China resulted in 25 fatalities among the 42-person crew, with 17 others evacuated to safety, according to Chinese state media reports. The incident raises questions about maritime safety protocols and emergency response procedures on international commercial vessels.

finance-markets.title: Global bond sell-off reignites as oil jumps to $109
finance-markets.summary: US Treasury yields reached fresh highs following a disappointing Treasury buyback operation by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, while oil prices surged to $109 per barrel. The bond sell-off reflects mounting inflation concerns and expectations for higher interest rates amid geopolitical tensions.

finance-markets.title: Global Bond Selloff Sends 10-Year Treasury Yields to Cusp of 5%
finance-markets.summary: Benchmark 10-year Treasury yields are approaching the psychologically significant 5% threshold as bond market bears dominate trading ahead of critical US inflation data. The move reflects intensifying expectations for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike at next week's meeting.

finance-markets.title: Saudi Arabia cuts oil output to lowest this year on Houthi threats
finance-markets.summary: The world's largest oil exporter has reduced production to its lowest level this year following Houthi threats and their announced maritime embargo against Saudi exports. The supply constraints are driving global oil prices higher and raising concerns about broader Middle Eastern stability.

finance-markets.title: Asian Stocks, Bonds Fall on Oil, Inflation Concern: Markets Wrap
finance-markets.summary: Asian equities and fixed income securities declined sharply as surging oil prices triggered a broader market sell-off and fresh inflation concerns. The decline reinforces investor bets on an imminent Federal Reserve interest-rate increase.

finance-markets.title: Japan's Producer Price Gains Stay Elevated, Backing BOJ Hikes
finance-markets.summary: Japanese corporate goods prices increased at a faster-than-expected pace in August, bolstering the Bank of Japan's case for continued interest-rate increases to combat inflationary pressures. The data strengthens the BOJ's hawkish monetary policy stance amid persistent price pressures.

finance-markets.title: Druckenmiller says US borrowing costs still 'a little low' despite surge in yields
finance-markets.summary: Prominent investor Stanley Druckenmiller and close ally of Federal Reserve Governor Kevin Warsh argue that current US borrowing costs remain insufficiently restrictive despite recent yield increases. The commentary suggests ongoing debate among policymakers and market participants over appropriate monetary policy levels.

finance-markets.title: Bearish Bets Build in Short India Bonds as Cash Drain Looms
finance-markets.summary: Traders are increasing short positions in India's short-term bonds amid expectations that yields will rise due to the central bank's efforts to withdraw excess liquidity from the banking system. The positioning reflects concerns about monetary tightening in the region's largest emerging market.

finance-markets.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 11
finance-markets.summary: Brent crude extended its rally as intensifying hostilities between Houthi militants and Saudi-backed forces in Yemen raised concerns about deeper Middle Eastern supply disruptions. The geopolitical tensions continue to support elevated oil prices across global markets.

finance-markets.title: China Halts New Battery Factories on Capacity Concerns: Caixin
finance-markets.summary: China has temporarily suspended construction of new battery and energy-storage manufacturing facilities pending a year-end industry capacity review. The halt signals growing concerns about overproduction and profitability in the strategic battery sector.

finance-markets.title: Gold Set for Weekly Drop as Oil, Inflation Boost Rate-Hike Bets
finance-markets.summary: Gold prices are tracking toward a third consecutive weekly decline as surging oil costs and elevated inflation readings strengthen market expectations for a near-term Federal Reserve rate increase. The metal faces headwinds from higher real interest rates as the Fed prepares to tighten monetary policy.

startups-vc.title: The Week's 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: Crusoe And Fluidstack Lead Multibillion-Dollar AI Infrastructure Haul
startups-vc.summary: AI infrastructure dominated venture capital activity this week, with Crusoe securing a $3 billion financing round and Fluidstack raising $1.5 billion. These multibillion-dollar investments underscore the continued concentration of venture funding in foundational AI and data center technologies.

startups-vc.title: Defense tech Mach Industries doubles valuation to $3.7B in 3 months
startups-vc.summary: Defense technology startup Mach Industries doubled its valuation to $3.7 billion in just three months by raising $900 million in a Series C extension round. The rapid growth reflects strong investor appetite for defense-focused technology solutions.

startups-vc.title: Bending Spoons to buy collaboration tools maker Miro for $1.36B, 90% less than its 2022 valuation
startups-vc.summary: Italian software company Bending Spoons is acquiring workplace collaboration platform Miro for $1.36 billion, representing a dramatic 90% decline from its $17.5 billion valuation in late 2021. The acquisition highlights the significant valuation corrections faced by high-flying enterprise software startups.

startups-vc.title: India's Pocket FM doubles revenue run rate to $500M as AI powers 93% of audio content
startups-vc.summary: Indian audio content platform Pocket FM has doubled its revenue run rate to $500 million by leveraging AI to produce 99% of new content, reducing production costs by approximately 80 times. The company's AI-first approach demonstrates significant operational efficiency gains in digital content creation.

startups-vc.title: 29 Companies Joined The Unicorn Board In August, Led By AI Software And Semiconductors
startups-vc.summary: Twenty-nine companies achieved unicorn status in August, contributing approximately $63 billion in aggregate value to the Crunchbase Unicorn Board, with more than a third being younger than three years old. The data underscores the accelerated time-to-unicorn trajectory for AI and semiconductor-focused startups.

startups-vc.title: Maven Robotics wants to steal your robot deployment deal
startups-vc.summary: Robotics startup Maven Robotics emerged from stealth with a $100 million Series A round and already has active customer deployments in place. The company's immediate operational traction demonstrates market demand for enterprise robotics solutions.

startups-vc.title: Furo's founders left Silicon Valley — and it's paying off
startups-vc.summary: Energy startup Furo secured $4 million in funding from primarily U.S.-based investors despite its three 28-year-old founders relocating from Silicon Valley to Germany. The funding success challenges conventional wisdom about the necessity of maintaining a Silicon Valley presence for venture capital attraction.

startups-vc.title: A Startup General Counsel Knew What Corporate Lawyers Needed From AI. So She Built It.
startups-vc.summary: Legal technology startup GC AI was co-founded by Cecilia Ziniti, a lawyer with nearly two decades of experience at companies including Amazon, Cruise, and Replit, alongside engineer Bardia Pourvakil. The venture combines legal expertise with software engineering to address in-house counsel needs for AI-driven solutions.

startups-vc.title: Google signs its biggest rice-methane carbon credit deal with Indian startup Mitti Labs
startups-vc.summary: Google has entered into a four-year carbon credit agreement with Indian startup Mitti Labs covering approximately 100,000 hectares of rice farms across three Indian states at peak delivery. The partnership demonstrates growing corporate investment in climate-focused agricultural technology startups.

startups-vc.title: How To Measure An Innovation Economy: South Korea
startups-vc.summary: Mind the Bridge chairman Alberto Onetti outlines how South Korea's emergence as the world's eighth-largest innovation ecosystem resulted from sustained government investment, startup support programs, regulatory reforms, and deep-tech policy initiatives. The analysis provides a framework for understanding how coordinated policy and capital structures shape national innovation competitiveness.

health-biotech.title: Platinum-based chemotherapy in childhood causes mutations that age the liver
health-biotech.summary: A new study reveals that platinum-based chemotherapy used to treat childhood cancers causes accelerated aging of liver cells, making them resemble adult liver tissue. This finding raises concerns about long-term health risks, including potential development of new tumors in treated patients later in life.

health-biotech.title: Cancer medicines remain in short supply across the U.S., survey finds
health-biotech.summary: A survey of leading cancer centers across the United States documents an ongoing shortage of cancer medications, forcing institutions to implement workaround strategies and disrupting clinical trial enrollment. The shortage continues to impact patient care and research pipelines at major oncology centers.

health-biotech.title: What to expect from UniQure's upcoming Huntington's gene therapy readout
health-biotech.summary: UniQure is expected to release four-year efficacy and safety data from a closely-watched clinical trial of its gene therapy for Huntington's disease before the end of September. The readout represents a significant milestone for gene therapy applications in neurodegenerative disease treatment.

health-biotech.title: FDA places partial hold on Biohaven's ion channel drug
health-biotech.summary: The FDA has issued a partial clinical hold on Biohaven's experimental epilepsy drug BHV-7000 following requests for additional preclinical safety data. The hold pauses the ongoing epilepsy study and comes shortly after the company divested rights to another therapy.

health-biotech.title: Why two promising heart drugs flopped and what's next
health-biotech.summary: Two experimental drugs that were anticipated to represent the next generation of heart disease treatment failed in clinical trials, prompting analysis of the reasons behind their setbacks. The failures highlight challenges in cardiovascular drug development and future direction of the field.

health-biotech.title: Shionogi's stroke drug fails mid-stage; Bayer's Hyrnuo gets expanded label
health-biotech.summary: Shionogi's experimental stroke therapy redasemtide failed to meet its primary endpoint in mid-stage trials, while Bayer received label expansion for its drug Hyrnuo. The contrasting outcomes reflect ongoing challenges in neurological drug development and differentiated commercial progress.

health-biotech.title: FDA expands Bayer lung cancer drug approval
health-biotech.summary: The FDA has granted expanded approval for Bayer's lung cancer drug, broadening its clinical indication. The approval represents regulatory progress in oncology therapeutics alongside other notable biotech developments including UniQure's gene therapy progress.

health-biotech.title: Pharmalittle: We're reading about a Novartis investor seeking a shake-up, a Gilead setback, and more
health-biotech.summary: A major Novartis shareholder has called for board restructuring following the pharmaceutical company's shares experiencing record losses due to clinical trial setbacks. The development reflects investor concerns about Novartis's pipeline performance and corporate governance.

health-biotech.title: FDA suggests regulatory flexibility for assessing psychedelics
health-biotech.summary: FDA regulators have signaled openness to innovative approaches for evaluating psychedelic therapies, including the use of alternative comparators beyond placebo controls. The regulatory guidance reflects evolving standards for assessing emerging mental health treatments.

health-biotech.title: BridgeBio Oncology slides as it tightens the scope of its KRAS program
health-biotech.summary: BridgeBio Oncology Therapeutics' stock price declined approximately 24 percent following the company's announcement to narrow its development pipeline and focus resources on its lead KRAS inhibitor candidate. The strategic pivot reflects prioritization decisions within the company's oncology portfolio.

crypto-web3.title: New Clarity Act text tweaks DeFi, credit union provisions, but road ahead for bill remains murky
crypto-web3.summary: Senate Republicans released a revised draft of the Clarity Act ahead of a critical vote scheduled for next week that requires 60 votes to pass. The updated legislation contains modifications to DeFi and credit union provisions as lawmakers continue negotiations on landmark cryptocurrency regulation.

crypto-web3.title: Europe's top regulator questions Polymarket and Kalshi's EU access, warns of authorization gaps
crypto-web3.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority raised concerns that event contracts offered by prediction market platforms may violate existing EU binary-options bans or fall under the scope of MiCA and national gambling laws. ESMA warned of authorization gaps that could prevent these platforms from legally operating in the EU.

crypto-web3.title: Why a new SEC plan could ease a legal headache for tokenized securities
crypto-web3.summary: The SEC's proposed overhaul of transfer-agent rules aims to eliminate duplicate offchain shareholder records, reducing reconciliation costs and legal uncertainty for issuers and investors in tokenized securities. The regulatory clarity could accelerate institutional adoption of blockchain-based securities infrastructure.

crypto-web3.title: Nasdaq to invest $100 million in Kraken parent Payward as firms expand partnership
crypto-web3.summary: Nasdaq Ventures committed a $100 million investment in Payward, Kraken's parent company, as the two firms deepen their collaboration on tokenized equity infrastructure. The partnership expansion underscores major institutional interest in blockchain-based securities trading platforms.

crypto-web3.title: Coinbase, Moov to bring stablecoin payment infrastructure to community banks and credit unions
crypto-web3.summary: Coinbase and Moov announced an integration combining Coinbase's Payments API and custodial wallets with Moov's existing payment platform to embed stablecoin infrastructure for community financial institutions. The partnership aims to bring blockchain-based payment rails to underserved banking segments.

crypto-web3.title: MoneyGram unveils stablecoin-backed card as digital dollars move into everyday spending
crypto-web3.summary: MoneyGram launched a Visa card enabling customers to hold and spend dollars from stablecoin-backed balances, expanding digital currency utility into consumer retail spending. The offering represents a significant step toward mainstream adoption of stablecoins for everyday transactions.

crypto-web3.title: Polymarket names former Amazon finance chief Warren Jenson as its first CFO
crypto-web3.summary: Polymarket appointed Warren Jenson, former Amazon finance executive, as its inaugural Chief Financial Officer as the prediction market platform builds out its regulated U.S. exchange and global infrastructure. The senior hire signals the platform's commitment to regulatory compliance and institutional operations.

crypto-web3.title: Nasdaq, Boerse Stuttgart, others ask EU to remove or increase cap in tokenization trial
crypto-web3.summary: A coalition of major exchanges including Nasdaq and Boerse Stuttgart petitioned EU regulators to eliminate or increase the cap on tokenization trials, arguing the current limit is too restrictive given existing European projects already exceed it. The request seeks to accelerate blockchain-based securities infrastructure development across the continent.

crypto-web3.title: OKX brings OpenAI and Anthropic bets to Europe as pre-IPO trading grows
crypto-web3.summary: OKX launched leveraged trading on private-company valuations alongside tokenized stocks and ETFs in Europe, offering up to 10x leverage on pre-IPO investments. The expansion reflects growing demand for alternative asset exposure and retail participation in private markets.

crypto-web3.title: Monument Bank delays retail tokenized deposits, cites regulatory issues in the UK
crypto-web3.summary: Monument Bank postponed its retail tokenized deposit rollout to November due to Financial Conduct Authority regulatory requirements, enlisting a Canadian custodian to meet compliance standards. The delay highlights ongoing challenges in bringing blockchain-based banking products to UK consumers.

cybersecurity.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
cybersecurity.summary: The FBI is investigating a dark web identity theft service offering digital scans of over 153 million driver's licenses from the United States and Canada. Evidence suggests the stolen data originates from a widely-used identity verification company based in Louisiana, representing one of the largest personal document breaches in recent memory.

cybersecurity.title: CISA Flags Exploited Cisco, Citrix, Fortinet Flaws, Sets Sept. 12 Federal Patch Deadline
cybersecurity.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added three actively exploited vulnerabilities affecting Cisco, Citrix, and Fortinet to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. Federal civilian agencies must apply patches by September 12, 2026, with one flaw carrying a critical 10.0 CVSS score.

cybersecurity.title: Check Point Discloses Two 9.8-Rated VPN Certificate Flaws Enabling Unauthenticated RCE
cybersecurity.summary: Check Point has patched two critical vulnerabilities (CVSS 9.8) in its firewall and management products that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution under specific conditions. The flaws affect Security Gateways and require immediate patching to prevent exploitation.

cybersecurity.title: PaperCut Attacker Uses Hundreds of AI Agents to Compromise 440+ Instances
cybersecurity.summary: A suspected Russian-speaking threat actor has leveraged artificial intelligence to develop exploits targeting recently disclosed PaperCut NG/MF vulnerabilities, successfully compromising over 440 instances. This represents an escalation in attack sophistication, demonstrating the operational use of AI in large-scale breach campaigns.

cybersecurity.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
cybersecurity.summary: Microsoft released updates addressing at least 398 security vulnerabilities across Windows operating systems and supported software, including one actively exploited flaw and two others previously disclosed publicly. The patches cover a wide range of severity levels and represent the company's latest monthly security maintenance cycle.

cybersecurity.title: Gigabud Creates Android Work Profiles to Hide From Banking App Malware Checks
cybersecurity.summary: The Gigabud banking trojan now employs a sophisticated evasion technique by installing a secondary Android app that creates a work profile containing tampered banking applications. This method allows the malware to bypass standard security checks by exploiting Android's separation between work and personal spaces.

cybersecurity.title: Google Play Early Access Abused to Push Thousands of Deceptive Android Apps
cybersecurity.summary: Threat actors are exploiting Google Play's Early Access program to distribute thousands of deceptive applications falsely promising money, rewards, and premium content. The scheme demonstrates how legitimate developer programs can be weaponized for mass distribution of fraudulent applications.

cybersecurity.title: Read This Before You Buy That TV Streaming Stick
cybersecurity.summary: A comprehensive analysis reveals that generic TV streaming devices engage in sophisticated fraud operations beyond previously known residential proxy abuse, including spoofing themselves as mobile devices to click ads on AI-generated websites. The devices participate in large-scale schemes to defraud online merchants and advertising networks.

cybersecurity.title: Nearly 1 in 10 Exposed LiteLLM Gateways Accepted the Example "sk-1234" Admin Key
cybersecurity.summary: Security research found that approximately 10 percent of internet-facing LiteLLM gateway servers continue to accept the default example admin key from the setup documentation. This critical misconfiguration allows unauthorized attackers to assume administrative access and read sensitive API keys and data.

cybersecurity.title: Voice Callers Exploit BYOD to Reach Microsoft 365, Corporate Data
cybersecurity.summary: Threat actors are leveraging Microsoft's Graph API to identify high-value targets within organizations, with stolen access subsequently transferred to extortion groups such as ShinyHunters. The attack chain exploits bring-your-own-device policies to gain initial access to corporate Microsoft 365 environments.

energy-climate.title: UK aviation emissions to be 50% higher than thought by 2050, government admits
energy-climate.summary: The UK government has revised its climate projections upward, acknowledging that aviation emissions will be 50% higher than previously forecast by 2050 due to reduced expectations for electric planes and sustainable aviation fuels. This represents a significant setback in the country's decarbonization strategy and highlights the challenges in transitioning hard-to-abate sectors.

energy-climate.title: Guest post: Why tough methane cuts are crucial for keeping warming 'well-below' 2C
energy-climate.summary: Methane, the second-largest contributor to global warming after CO2, requires aggressive mitigation efforts to limit temperature rise to well below 2 degrees Celsius. Rapid methane reductions offer a near-term opportunity to slow warming and complement longer-term carbon dioxide reduction strategies.

energy-climate.title: Climate change exposes 580 million children to 20 extra 'heat-stress days' every year
energy-climate.summary: Over 40% of children under age 10 globally are experiencing at least 20 additional heat-stress days annually due to climate change, creating severe health and development risks for vulnerable populations. This finding underscores the disproportionate impact of climate change on children and highlights the urgency of mitigation efforts.

energy-climate.title: How this summer's heat and drought impacted crops in Europe – in six charts
energy-climate.summary: European farmers face significant challenges following extreme heat, drought, and wildfires that devastated crop production across the continent. The analysis demonstrates climate change's immediate economic and food security implications for major agricultural regions.

energy-climate.title: Analysis: UK solar power hits record high over summer 2026
energy-climate.summary: UK solar power generation achieved new record levels during summer 2026, driven by elevated temperatures and continued expansion of renewable capacity. The milestone demonstrates the growing role of solar in the nation's energy mix and renewable energy transition.

energy-climate.title: Romania allocates €650 million for solar, storage at public buildings
energy-climate.summary: Romania has launched new subsidy schemes with €650 million in funding to support solar and battery storage installations at public institutions, with coverage up to 100% of project costs. The initiative strengthens Europe's renewable energy infrastructure and demonstrates commitment to clean energy deployment at scale.

energy-climate.title: South Korea sets up committee to rebuild domestic solar manufacturing
energy-climate.summary: South Korea has established a government committee to revitalize its domestic solar manufacturing sector and develop next-generation cell technology amid competitive pressure from Chinese producers. The initiative aims to strengthen the country's energy independence and technological capabilities in renewable energy.

energy-climate.title: Longi, Soochow University unveil 34.0% perovskite-silicon tandem solar cell based on dual-anchored interfacial design
energy-climate.summary: Researchers have achieved a significant breakthrough in perovskite-silicon tandem solar cell efficiency at 34%, employing a novel interfacial design that reduces recombination losses and improves stability. This advancement represents progress toward next-generation solar technologies with substantially higher conversion efficiencies.

energy-climate.title: Thailand paves the way for 10 GW of rooftop solar
energy-climate.summary: Thailand's updated Power Development Plan targets 50% clean energy within a decade and includes deployment of an additional 10 GW of rooftop solar capacity. The initiative positions the country as a regional leader in distributed renewable energy expansion.

energy-climate.title: Merchant BESS switched on at operational solar site in Romania
energy-climate.summary: Econergy has commenced commercial operations at its 70 MW/141 MWh battery energy storage system in Romania, integrated with an existing 92 MW solar facility to form a 162 MW hybrid installation. The merchant storage asset can capitalize on arbitrage opportunities while supporting grid stability, with projected annual storage revenues of €9.7 million.

asia-pacific.title: Can a US$6 trillion South Korea-Japan economic bloc succeed?
asia-pacific.summary: South Korea and Japan are exploring deeper trade integration as the global economic order fragments due to tariff wars and supply-chain disruptions from regional conflicts. Business leaders and analysts argue the two neighbours could benefit substantially from partnership despite historical tensions, potentially creating a major economic bloc.

asia-pacific.title: Moonshot, DeepSeek secretly routed user requests to Claude, Anthropic claims
asia-pacific.summary: Anthropic has accused Chinese AI competitors DeepSeek and Moonshot of covertly routing customer requests to Claude models and presenting the responses as their own, escalating US-China tensions in the artificial intelligence sector. The allegations follow earlier claims by US government agencies including the NSA and FBI regarding Chinese AI industry practices.

asia-pacific.title: Tech, EV and aerospace executives likely to join Xi's US trip to mirror Trump team
asia-pacific.summary: Beijing is preparing to send senior executives from technology, electric vehicle, and aerospace sectors to accompany President Xi Jinping to Washington later this month as part of a high-stakes diplomatic visit. The delegation composition signals China's intent to demonstrate economic strength while both nations race to finalise details of the closely watched engagement.

asia-pacific.title: China rebuts top US diplomat Marco Rubio over 'Communist Party-backed projects' in Peru
asia-pacific.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio met Peruvian leadership to counter China's expanding influence around the strategic Chancay megaport, with China's Lima embassy issuing a sharp rebuttal defending its investments. The engagement reflects intensifying US-China competition for influence over critical infrastructure in Latin America's Pacific region.

asia-pacific.title: Can Southeast Asia Benefit From the China-US AI Race?
asia-pacific.summary: Southeast Asian nations face critical decisions as Washington and Beijing compete to leverage artificial intelligence for geopolitical influence in the region. The analysis examines what benefits Southeast Asia can negotiate while managing expectations regarding technological dependencies and strategic alignment.

asia-pacific.title: Vietnam's To Lam Concludes State Visit to Russia, Departs For France
asia-pacific.summary: Vietnamese leader To Lam completed a state visit to Russia where he and President Vladimir Putin identified trade and energy cooperation as priorities, before departing for France. The diplomatic engagement underscores Vietnam's balancing act between major powers amid regional geopolitical tensions.

asia-pacific.title: What's a Northern Metropolis-like project doing in Malaysia? Lessons for Hong Kong?
asia-pacific.summary: Malaysia's rapid expansion of digital infrastructure and regional development near Singapore offers potential lessons for Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis initiative. The analysis examines how cross-border infrastructure projects and digital development are reshaping the economic dynamics of Southeast Asian border regions.

asia-pacific.title: East Asia's Quiet Race to Find the Universe's Missing Mass
asia-pacific.summary: China, South Korea, and Japan are each operating competitive dark matter detection programmes, with some achieving world-leading sensitivity levels in fundamental physics research. The regional scientific competition reflects East Asia's growing investment in advanced research infrastructure and scientific prestige.

asia-pacific.title: Hong Kong home prices headed for 15% gain this year, Midland forecast says
asia-pacific.summary: Hong Kong property prices are projected to rise 15 percent year-on-year while remaining 16 percent below their 2021 peak, with local banks unlikely to follow any Federal Reserve rate increases. The forecast reflects cautious optimism about Hong Kong's real estate market recovery amid uncertain monetary conditions.

asia-pacific.title: Why Have Indians Become a Regular Target of Hate in Singapore?
asia-pacific.summary: Rising resentment toward Singapore's Indian community and Indian nationals reflects growing social tensions within the multicultural city-state. The trend raises concerns about interethnic relations and social cohesion in one of Asia's most economically developed nations.
